name: Yautja Hunter
appearance: Tall muscular Jungle Hunter Yautja alien hunter, mottled olive-brown reptilian skin, broad mandibles, long black dreadlocks with metal beads, original smooth silver bio-mask, asymmetrical weathered grey-bronze armour, black netted bodysuit and brown loincloth, clawed alien feet. Two long wrist blades extend from anatomical right wrist; the original small shoulder-mounted plasma caster is above anatomical left shoulder. The 1987 character does NOT carry a smart disc or City Hunter combi-stick.
action: His physical finishing sequence is a measured wrist-blade extension and forward close thrust with the right wrist, then withdrawal. For ordinary attack do the same wristblade motion without any gun shot.

name: City Hunter
appearance: Tall muscular City Hunter Yautja, orange and brown mottled skin, broad mandibles, black metal-beaded dreadlocks, distinctive angular dark bronze bio-mask with horizontal visor, bronze layered asymmetric armour and netted suit, brown loincloth. Holds the Predator2 long metallic segmented combi-stick spear, with retracted wristblades. His gear belongs to Predator2 rather than Jungle Hunter1987.
action: Finishing sequence: grip the long combi-stick spear firmly, extend into a controlled forward lunge and spear thrust, then retract. Ordinary attack uses the same physical spear, no glowing magic, no projectile disc.

name: Dutch Schaefer
sourceWork: Predator (1987), Dutch before final mud-trap sequence
appearance: Adult Dutch Schaefer as Arnold Schwarzenegger in Predator1987, strong broad human face, short brown crew-cut hair, muscular arms, olive-green sleeveless military shirt, green/brown woodland camouflage trousers, military belt and boots. Holds the conventional black M16A1 rifle with its underbarrel M203 launcher. Keep a human military silhouette, NO sci-fi plasma caster, no tactical helmet and no alien armour.
action: Finishing sequence: bring the ordinary M16 rifle to shoulder, aim, one short conventional muzzle flash in the THIRD frame only, settle after recoil. Ordinary attack uses one rifle shot at the third frame.

name: Anna Gonsalves
appearance: Adult Anna Gonsalves in Predator1987, slender human Guatemalan woman with tan-brown skin, straight dark shoulder-length hair, a worn light-grey sleeveless shirt, olive field trousers, brown belt and simple boots. No firearm, knife, alien gear or magic. Preserve human proportions and serious alert expression.
action: Finishing scene is zero-damage support: notice a safe path, point clearly toward it, give a quiet regrouping hand signal, lower her hand. Ordinary action is the same safe-route pointing gesture. Never imply her words deal damage or create a glowing shield.

name: Billy Sole
sourceWork: Predator (1987), Billy with field equipment before bridge scene
appearance: Adult Billy Sole as Sonny Landham in Predator1987, very tall powerful Native American human tracker, tan-brown skin, long straight black hair, dark brown eyes, black sleeveless military vest or shirt, woodland camouflage trousers, boots and ordinary military belt. Holds his recognizable large steel machete in anatomical right hand at controlled safe angle. No self-cutting, no exposed wounds and no supernatural power.
action: Finishing sequence: take a deliberate machete guard, step and swing one controlled horizontal physical cut away from viewer, recover with blade low. Ordinary action uses the machete. No blood, injury or enemy.

name: Mac Eliot
sourceWork: Predator (1987), Mac with M60 machine gun
appearance: Adult Mac Eliot as Bill Duke in Predator1987, tall muscular Black American man with dark skin and closely shaven bald head, black sleeveless military top, woodland camouflage trousers, green webbing straps, ammunition belt and military boots. Carries the conventional M60 belt-fed machine gun with its real stock and long barrel. No laser, alien armour or futuristic rifle.
action: Finishing sequence: brace the real M60, align barrel toward screen-right, short ordinary muzzle flash in the THIRD frame only, settle with recoil controlled. Ordinary attack fires once in the third frame.

name: Mike Harrigan
appearance: Adult Mike Harrigan as Danny Glover in Predator2 1990, tall middle-aged Black American detective, dark skin, short black hair, black moustache, pale beige short-sleeved button-up shirt open over a white undershirt, dark brown trousers, leather belt/holster and dark shoes. Holds his standard ordinary handgun in a two-handed grip. No sleeveless pink shirt, military camo, alien weapons or science-fiction guns.
action: Finishing sequence: raise the conventional handgun in two hands, steady aim, one small ordinary muzzle flash at the third frame, lower weapon after recoil. Ordinary attack fires at the third frame.

name: Greyback Elder
appearance: Very tall elder Greyback Yautja from Predator2 final ship scene: weathered mottled grey and ochre skin, unmasked four facial mandibles, long pale grey dreadlocks decorated with rings, aged bronze asymmetrical chest and shoulder armour over black mesh bodysuit, reddish brown loincloth, clawed hands and feet. Holds ONLY the old 18th-century Raphael Adolini1715 flintlock pistol in his anatomical right hand, low and unfired. No modern rifle, no giant cannon and no invented helmet.
action: Finishing/support sequence: assess the opponent, bring the old flintlock low across his palm, present it as a respectful trophy handover, settle in a composed nod. It is a non-firing presentation, not a magic buff ray. Ordinary attack is a cautious bare left claw hand motion without discharging this antique.

name: Naru
appearance: Naru from Prey2022, an adult Comanche HUMAN woman about20, tan-brown skin, long dark hair with small braids, dark eyes, practical worn brown deerskin fringed tunic and leggings, simple leather belt with pouches, soft brown boots, natural fibre details. A small orange-red warpaint band across her eyes/cheeks. Holds her ordinary stone/metal-edged tomahawk with a real attached rope loop in anatomical right hand. No alien face, mandibles, reptile armour or futuristic gear. Fully clothed practical hunting costume, accurate human silhouette.
action: Finishing sequence: brace the rope-tethered tomahawk, extend a short controlled tomahawk strike, pull the real rope back with the opposite hand, recover with hatchet low. No magic, glowing rope, giant axe or animal summon. Ordinary action is a compact tomahawk cut.

name: Royce
appearance: Adult Royce as Adrien Brody in Predators2010, lean athletic human man with pale olive skin, short messy dark hair, lean long face and light dark stubble, dark olive-green tactical shirt, olive/brown plate carrier, tactical trousers, military belt and boots. Carries the distinctive conventional AA-12 automatic shotgun with its round black drum magazine. No alien plasma, M60 belt feed or oversized rifle.
action: Finishing sequence: shoulder the AA-12 with visible drum magazine, aim to screen-right, single small muzzle flash in the THIRD frame, control recoil then lower it. Ordinary attack fires in third frame.
